model_annotation: This donut chart visualizes the distribution of data across two nested categorical dimensions: “Ambiguity Std (Outer)” and “Max Ambiguity (Inner)”. The outer ring, representing “Ambiguity Std”, is divided into four segments corresponding to standard deviation values of 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94, with respective proportions of 49.0%, 47.7%, 7.0%, and 5.0%. The inner ring, labeled “Max Ambiguity”, shows three segments for maximum ambiguity values of 1, 2, and 3, accounting for 38.0%, 39.0%, and 14.2% of the total. Each segment is color-coded according to its legend, with darker blues for higher standard deviations and lighter blues for higher maximum ambiguity values. The chart uses percentage labels within each segment and includes two separate legends to clarify the mapping of colors to categories for both rings.
